title: F-16 Dogfight Game with ThreeJS
author: shottycoin
selftext: I was just experimenting with the skybox integration to Pixelfork. Then accidentally :D made F-16 Dogfight game which looks not bad for 3 prompts. Would love to hear your feedbacks. Planning to add SFX for next update.

comments.author: Nasdali
comments.body: Nice. The handling and camera looks fun, and that skybox looks fantastic as well.

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: Thank you. Playing is also fun. I didn't expect AI can build these VFX so good. It surprised me.

comments.author: Leather_Tomorrow4993
comments.body: with SFX this would look so good! good job 👍🏻

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: Yea I added SFX , however it does not work on Safari, dunno why but will try to fix it. Meanwhile you can use chrome for better SFX experience.

comments.author: shottycoin
comments.body:
Hey all, as many of you requested here is the playable link: [https://pixelfork.ai/publish/ff032661-e716-4067-a233-3df3723fe327](https://pixelfork.ai/publish/ff032661-e716-4067-a233-3df3723fe327) 

I also added Multiplayer Mode where you can create a room and share the room code with your friends. Then you will join same server. Sometimes   
  
SFX is also added. Sounds good ngl. 

Note 1: SFX is not working in Safari. Please use Chrome or Firefox for sound effects.   
Note 2: Sometimes servers going to sleep, and when you create the room, it may take 30 seconds for cold start.
